title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.24793v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. translated_title: 问题中的大象：统一模型描绘其答案背后的概念
translated_abstract: 可视化中间表示有助于我们检视模型输出背后的推理步骤。统一多模态模型在同一架构中融合了理解与生成，为实现这一目标提供了机会：其图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表示。我们提出V-lens，利用这一连接，无需训练解码器即可可视化所选token的隐藏状态。在四个基于扩散模型和两个纯自回归的统一模型上，生成的图像揭示了连接问题与答案的关键中间概念，即使这些概念从未被明确提及。对照实验展示了这些可视化内容如何随上下文、token位置和模型深度而变化。随后我们提出lens tuning（透镜调优），通过V-lens用图像对选定的隐藏状态施加监督。在BAGEL、SenseNova-U1和HunyuanImage-3.0上，代词指代对象的正确可视化率显著提升（原摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出无需训练解码器的V-lens方法，利用统一多模态模型图像生成器对文本隐藏状态的访问能力，可视化模型推理中连接问题与答案的关键中间概念，并通过lens tuning显著提升代词指代等概念的可视化准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces V-lens, a training-free method that visualizes token hidden states through unified multimodal models' image generators to reveal key intermediate concepts connecting questions to answers, and further proposes lens tuning to substantially improve visualization accuracy of concepts such as pronoun referents.
